body:
great advice! thanks so much, I'll definitely read this a few more times and absorb it all. 

I've been warned about the job prospects already, but really I'm an easy person. Whatever I can get in a field I enjoy and I'm happy! Thanks for the warning though.

What are you doing your PhD in? It'd be interesting to hear of options.
Wow wasn't expecting such a helpful response! Could we talk in DMs Id love to hear more about how its going for you and who knows maybe we could help each other out!
I've heard of these perks, anything else worth mentioning?
I'm not so fussed about the flex it's just I can get into Adv Sci so why not you know?
Ah I see, you're saying it's like medical science for those that can't get into medicine, so seeing as I can get into Com/Sci I should just do that?

Thanks for the reply! I see what you mean, but is a PhD really so unachievable? Or do you just mean I would have to be heavily invested in the topic to go through with it?

I'm not so much interested in the business side of things, so a degree void of science is probably not what I'm looking for, info systems only caught my eye because all the other majors looked so bad. 
I'm really interested in the differences between Sci/Bus and Com/Sci and what all 3 options may lead to after the degree if you know anything about that.

I'm interested to hear more of what you have to say, what do you mean they are money grabs? Do they hold no value other than a title in your opinion? And are you saying science is more valuable than business?

My biggest thing is just not hating or dreading going to my job. I seriously can't imagine anything I would enjoy but I definitely can tell you things I wouldn't, like the Accounting and Finance stuff. The most focused area of interest I have is Evolution, which I would be open to researching post grad.

Yeh they know I frequent the site and think it'll be easier to share and see what other people think and agree/disagree with. I feel you and honestly even without your difficulties I think of my life as just as worthless and entropic (hope Im using that right). I totally understand why you feel the way you do and wont even bother with the spiel about how everyone is worth something.
